comment: The two pitch jacks are clamped to between -1V and +2V at Jawari.cpp:163-164, so the instrument only transposes over three octaves however far the cable goes, and they are read inside doStep() rather than in process(), which is why a pitch change is only taken up at the next strum. The bridge CV at line 261 is added to the slider without any scaling, so a single volt sweeps the whole control rather than the ten volts the rest of the plugin uses. The strings are Karplus-Strong plucks with a comb filter alongside, mixed by the bridge control, and the output is run through a DC blocker and a gain compensation at lines 299-304.
